title: Top account by paid revenue, per segment, 2025
prompt: For each account segment, which single account generated the most paid invoice revenue in 2025? You'll need to go from invoices to account totals before you can rank within segment.
population: Paid invoices issued in 2025, joined to accounts for segment.
grain: Starts at one row per invoice → account × segment totals → ranked within segment → final: one row per segment (its top account).
metricDefinition: sum(amount) for paid invoices in 2025, per account; the account with the highest total per segment.
transformationPlan: aggregate paid 2025 invoices to account totals, joined to accounts for segment
rank accounts within each segment by total paid, descending
referenceSql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.segment, i.account_id, sum(i.amount) AS total_paid FROM invoices i JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = i.account_id WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND i.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY a.segment, i.account_id), ranked AS (SELECT segment, account_id, total_paid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_paid DESC) AS rn FROM account_totals) SELECT segment, account_id, total_paid FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
